attributes.board_name: New Hampshire Board of Medicine (Office of Professional Licensure and Certification)

rules.accepted_credit_types: Category 1 (AMA PRA-equivalent, as in Med 402.01) at least 40 hours; Category II at most 60 hours
rules.alternatives: Maintaining NCCPA national certification (or its successor) instead of the 100 hours.
rules.audit_note: Proof of national certification or CME credit hours is submitted with the renewal application. Board of Medicine CE is tracked through CE Broker.
rules.notes: 100 credit hours per renewal period. New Hampshire now titles PAs 'physician associate'. Renewal under OPLC rules Plc 308 (cycle not stated in Med 600). The 3-hour pain/addiction CE for PDMP registrants (Med 402.01(o), RSA 318-B:40) is in the physician chapter; whether it binds PAs was not confirmed.
rules.legal_basis: N.H. Admin. Rules Med 613.01; RSA 328-D:1, I-a
